lines.zh: 板甲压得我每一步都很沉。
lines.en: The plate drags every step heavy.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往前推，像堵墙。
lines.en: I push forward a step at a time, like a wall.

lines.zh: 肩甲蹭着胸甲，吱吱作响。
lines.en: Pauldron grinds on breastplate with a squeal.

lines.zh: 走得慢，但我不会退。
lines.en: Slow going, but I won't give ground.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，免得被撞倒。
lines.en: I lower my weight so nothing tips me.

lines.zh: 绿方的重装，走在队列正中。
lines.en: Green's heavy foot, marching in the center.

lines.zh: 每走一步，地面都轻轻一震。
lines.en: The ground shivers a little with each stride.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥地，陷进去就麻烦。
lines.en: I skirt the mud; sinking in would be trouble.

lines.zh: 铁靴踩碎石板，碎得很干脆。
lines.en: Iron boots crack the flagstone cleanly.

lines.zh: 我拖着长戟，尖端在土上划线。
lines.en: I drag my halberd; its point plows a line.

lines.zh: 风从盔孔灌进来，凉得清醒。
lines.en: Wind hisses through my helm's vents and wakes me.

lines.zh: 我走向队伍空出的那一角。
lines.en: I trudge toward the gap in the line.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，也是一种威慑。
lines.en: Standing still is a threat of its own.

lines.zh: 盔里太闷，我只能慢点呼吸。
lines.en: It's close in this helm; I breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 我把戟杆立在脚边，扶稳。
lines.en: I plant the halberd shaft beside my foot.

lines.zh: 铁甲晒得发烫，我却不敢脱。
lines.en: The sun heats my plate, and I dare not shed it.

lines.zh: 队里没人说话，只有甲片响。
lines.en: No one speaks in the rank, only armor clicks.

lines.zh: 我数着对面的盾牌有几面。
lines.en: I count the shields across the field.

lines.zh: 膝盖旧伤又开始发酸了。
lines.en: My old knee wound is aching again.

lines.zh: 有人拍我肩甲，我懒得回头。
lines.en: Someone taps my pauldron; I don't bother turning.

lines.zh: 我站得笔直，让新兵看着学。
lines.en: I stand straight so the recruits can copy me.

lines.zh: 这身甲要两个人才能卸下来。
lines.en: It takes two men to get me out of this.

lines.zh: 我抬抬手，试试关节还顺不顺。
lines.en: I lift my arm to test the joints.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，影子慢慢爬过盾面。
lines.en: The sun shifts; a shadow crawls across my shield.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，矮了一头。
lines.en: You stand before me, a head shorter.

lines.zh: 我这身板甲，砍十下也未必破。
lines.en: Ten cuts might not open this plate.

lines.zh: 想试试我的戟有多沉吗？
lines.en: Care to test how heavy my halberd is?

lines.zh: 你盯着我的甲缝，我看见了。
lines.en: You're staring at my armor's seams. I noticed.

lines.zh: 退开，我不想为你挪步。
lines.en: Back off; I don't want to move for you.

lines.zh: 你的刀在我胸甲上留不下印。
lines.en: Your blade won't even mark my breastplate.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，盔孔正对着你。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly; my visor slit faces you.

lines.zh: 绿方重装不跟人闲聊。
lines.en: Green heavy infantry doesn't chat.

lines.zh: 绿方重甲，走慢但打不穿。
lines.en: Green faction plate — slow, but you can't punch through.

lines.zh: 站那么近，你要么勇敢，要么蠢。
lines.en: Standing that close — brave or foolish?

lines.zh: 我在等你先动，我好省点力气。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first, to save my strength.

lines.zh: 我抬脚半步，地面就响了一下。
lines.en: I shift half a step; the ground answers.

lines.zh: 甲挡住了，但我还是闷哼一声。
lines.en: The plate held, but I still grunt.

lines.zh: 这一下打得甲片凹了进去。
lines.en: That one dented a plate.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，又重新站直。
lines.en: I sway once, then straighten again.

lines.zh: 有东西从缝隙里钻进来了。
lines.en: Something slipped in through a gap.

lines.zh: 疼得我握戟的手一松。
lines.en: It stings enough that my grip slips.

lines.zh: 甲缝渗血，我把面罩扣得更紧。
lines.en: Blood seeps through the seams, so I clamp my visor tighter.

lines.zh: 这身甲也不是万能的。
lines.en: This armor isn't invincible after all.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是这辈子第一次。
lines.en: I give half a step — a first for me.

lines.zh: 铁甲里全是我的喘气声。
lines.en: Inside the plate it's all my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我扶着戟，慢慢把气匀回来。
lines.en: I lean on the halberd and steady my breath.

lines.zh: 吃的？我得先把面罩掀开。
lines.en: Food? I'd have to lift my visor first.

lines.zh: 一把好锤比一顿饭更让我动心。
lines.en: A good hammer tempts me more than a meal.

lines.zh: 我不追东西，太重了跑不动。
lines.en: I don't chase things; too heavy to run.

lines.zh: 你要是给我一块铁，我倒是看看。
lines.en: Hand me an ingot and I'll take a look.

lines.zh: 拿吃的勾我没用，盔甲太沉。
lines.en: Food won't lure me; this armor is too heavy.

lines.zh: 我隔着面罩闻了闻，是烤肉。
lines.en: I sniff through my visor — roast meat.

lines.zh: 重装兵不该为一口吃的离开队列。
lines.en: Heavy infantry shouldn't leave ranks for a bite.

lines.zh: 你举得那么高，我够不到。
lines.en: You're holding it too high; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 我伸手，结果只摸到空气。
lines.en: I reach out and close my fist on nothing.

lines.zh: 先记下这份人情，回头再算。
lines.en: I'll note the favor and settle up later.

lines.zh: 撞上来像撞一堵铁墙吧。
lines.en: Hitting me must feel like an iron wall.

lines.zh: 你撞上胸甲，我连半步都没挪。
lines.en: You struck my breastplate; I did not shift half a step.

lines.zh: 别推，我这身甲不会让路。
lines.en: Don't push; this armor doesn't yield.

lines.zh: 你撞到我戟杆上了。
lines.en: You walked into my halberd shaft.

lines.zh: 站稳点，我脚下一寸不移。
lines.en: Steady yourself; I'm not shifting an inch.

lines.zh: 我听见你骨头撞铁的闷响。
lines.en: I hear the dull knock of bone on iron.

lines.zh: 绕开我，从旁边过。
lines.en: Go around me. Use the side.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我肩甲歪了点。
lines.en: That knock skewed my pauldron a touch.

lines.zh: 你太小看这身重量了。
lines.en: You underestimated this much weight.

lines.zh: 我挪半步，地砖都松了。
lines.en: I move half a step and the tiles loosen.

lines.zh: 卸甲要半个时辰，你等得起？
lines.en: Half an hour to strip this plate — can you wait?

lines.zh: 重装兵不谈这个，站好。
lines.en: Heavy infantry doesn't discuss that. Stand straight.

lines.zh: 我只跟战功谈，不跟人谈。
lines.en: I deal in battle honors, not in this.

lines.zh: 铁甲里连呼吸都费劲，别闹。
lines.en: Breathing is work in here; don't start.

lines.zh: 队列还站着，我不能转头。
lines.en: The rank is formed; I can't turn my head.

lines.zh: 等这场仗打完再说。
lines.en: Let's talk after this battle is over.

lines.zh: 我连膝盖都弯不利索。
lines.en: I can hardly bend my knees.

lines.zh: 同伴之间只谈盾墙怎么排。
lines.en: Comrades discuss shield walls, nothing else.

lines.zh: 你先把我的护腕扣解开。
lines.en: Start by undoing my bracer clasp.

lines.zh: 这身甲是绿方发的，不是我的。
lines.en: This armor is green's property, not mine.

lines.zh: 地上有块弯铁片，能回炉。
lines.en: A bent iron scrap — it can go back to the forge.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，但捡到了。
lines.en: I bend slowly, and I get it.

lines.zh: 这枚断箭的箭头还能用。
lines.en: This broken arrowhead is still good.

lines.zh: 我把铁钉一颗颗拾起来。
lines.en: I pick up the nails one by one.

lines.zh: 有人掉了护手，我先拿着。
lines.en: Someone dropped a gauntlet; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我捡起敌人的断剑看了看。
lines.en: I pick up an enemy's snapped sword and look it over.

lines.zh: 沉重的铁块，我一手就提起来。
lines.en: A heavy iron lump — I lift it one-handed.

lines.zh: 我把面包塞进胸甲缝里。
lines.en: I tuck the bread into a gap in my breastplate.

lines.zh: 地上那面破盾我踩了一脚。
lines.en: I step on the broken shield lying there.

lines.zh: 我捡东西得先蹲下来，很费劲。
lines.en: To pick things up, I must squat. It's an effort.

lines.zh: 看见你了，别指望我追不上。
lines.en: I see you. Don't assume I can't catch you.

lines.zh: 我举起戟，指向你的方向。
lines.en: I raise my halberd and point it at you.

lines.zh: 红方的影，正好试试这身甲。
lines.en: A red silhouette — good chance to test this plate.

lines.zh: 前面的，站住别跑。
lines.en: You there, halt. Don't run.

lines.zh: 我锁定目标，脚跟先扎稳。
lines.en: I mark the target and set my heels.

lines.zh: 这次我不用喊了，直接压过去。
lines.en: No shouting this time; I'll just roll over you.

lines.zh: 你挡在我和营门之间。
lines.en: You're between me and the camp gate.

lines.zh: 我把戟横过来，封住退路。
lines.en: I turn the halberd sideways and close your escape.

lines.zh: 你的铠甲看起来很薄。
lines.en: Your armor looks thin.

lines.zh: 我把面罩放下了，这是宣战。
lines.en: I lower my visor. That's a declaration.

lines.zh: 来吧，我脚下这寸地不让。
lines.en: Come on. I yield not one inch here.

lines.zh: 目标确认，绿方重装前进。
lines.en: Target confirmed; green heavy advances.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个跑得最快的。
lines.en: I fix on the one who runs fastest.

lines.zh: 你那面红盾，我要挂到营门上。
lines.en: That red shield of yours will hang above the camp gate.

lines.zh: 你绕左，我就往左挪半步。
lines.en: You go left; I shift half a step left.

lines.zh: 我的视线被盔沿挡住，但还跟着你。
lines.en: My visor blocks the view, but I still track you.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也得回来补给。
lines.en: Run all you like; you'll come back to resupply.

lines.zh: 这一寸一寸的，我不着急。
lines.en: Inch by inch. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你挥空了两下，我在等第三下。
lines.en: You've swung twice into air. I'm waiting for the third.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我全记着。
lines.en: I've got every one of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我把戟尖压低，跟着你的胸口。
lines.en: I drop the halberd point and follow your chest.

lines.zh: 你喘得越响，我越清楚你在哪。
lines.en: The louder you pant, the better I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我在数你的步子，八步一停。
lines.en: I count your paces: eight, then a pause.

lines.zh: 别想从我的侧面过去。
lines.en: Don't plan on getting past my flank.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，铁甲一路响。
lines.en: I turn slowly, armor rasping the whole way.

lines.zh: 我们的距离在缩，你该知道。
lines.en: The gap is closing. You should know that.

lines.zh: 你跳上墙，我就守着墙根。
lines.en: You climb the wall; I hold the base of it.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比这身甲还厚。
lines.en: My patience is thicker than this plate.

lines.zh: 你把盾举高也没用，我砸得动。
lines.en: Raise that shield all you like; I can break it.

lines.zh: 我看见你换手了，左手更弱。
lines.en: You switched hands. Your left is weaker.

lines.zh: 再退，你就退进壕沟了。
lines.en: Keep backing up and you'll be in the ditch.

lines.zh: 戟杆砸下来，接着是戟刃。
lines.en: The halberd shaft comes down, then the blade.

lines.zh: 我这一击能把盾劈开。
lines.en: This blow can split a shield.

lines.zh: 铁靴往前一踏，我顺势劈落。
lines.en: One iron stomp forward, and I chop down.

lines.zh: 铁甲太重，可我一寸寸压过来。
lines.en: Iron plate is heavy, but I advance inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我抬起戟尾，捅向你的腹侧。
lines.en: I raise the halberd's butt and jab your flank.

lines.zh: 这一记是往下砸，不是横砍。
lines.en: This one comes down, not across.

lines.zh: 沉重的一击，连地面都闷响。
lines.en: A heavy strike; even the ground thuds.

lines.zh: 我抡圆了戟，把你逼退两步。
lines.en: I swing the halberd wide and drive you back two steps.

lines.zh: 甲片替我挡住你的反击。
lines.en: My plates absorb your counter.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我的戟尖跟着。
lines.en: You reach the wall; my point follows.

lines.zh: 我砸你的膝弯，让你站不住。
lines.en: I hammer your knee to take your footing.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在你的护肩上。
lines.en: That one landed on your shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 我不换招，就是一下一下砸。
lines.en: No fancy moves — I just hammer, again and again.

lines.zh: 我的戟刃拖过石地，火星直冒。
lines.en: My halberd blade scrapes stone and throws sparks.

lines.zh: 你后退时踩空了半级台阶。
lines.en: You miss a step as you retreat.

lines.zh: 我再上前一步，把你压向墙。
lines.en: One more step and I pin you to the wall.

lines.zh: 这一击我用上了全身重量。
lines.en: I put my whole weight behind this one.

lines.zh: 第三戟落下时，你的盾沿会裂。
lines.en: By the third halberd blow, your shield rim will split.

lines.zh: 营门打开，我拖着戟走出来。
lines.en: The gate opens and I drag my halberd out.

lines.zh: 我穿着新打的板甲，铁味很重。
lines.en: I wear freshly forged plate; the iron smell is strong.

lines.zh: 队列让开半步，让我上前。
lines.en: The rank parts half a step to let me through.

lines.zh: 我从塔楼的阴影里踏入阳光。
lines.en: I step from the tower's shade into the sun.

lines.zh: 重装分队到齐，我站在最前。
lines.en: The heavy squad's complete; I stand foremost.

lines.zh: 工匠敲了敲我的胸甲，说成了。
lines.en: The smith taps my breastplate and calls it done.

lines.zh: 地面一震，我踩上了石阶。
lines.en: The ground shakes as I mount the steps.

lines.zh: 我把戟扛在肩上，走到岗位。
lines.en: I shoulder the halberd and walk to my post.

lines.zh: 绿方需要一堵墙，我来了。
lines.en: Green needed a wall, and here I am.

lines.zh: 盔甲一片片扣好，我才迈步。
lines.en: Only once every plate is buckled do I move.

lines.zh: 我从关着的门后推开一条缝。
lines.en: I push a gap out of the shut door.

lines.zh: 号角把我从营帐里叫了出来。
lines.en: The horn calls me out of the tent.

lines.zh: 火烤着铁甲，我像被关在炉里。
lines.en: Fire heats the plate; I'm shut inside an oven.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，甲都撞散了。
lines.en: I roll down the steps and my plates scatter.

lines.zh: 水从盔孔灌进来，我扑腾着上浮。
lines.en: Water pours in through my visor; I flail upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀掉我一片肩甲。
lines.en: The blast tears a pauldron off me.

lines.zh: 箭矢打中胸甲，弹开时震得我后退。
lines.en: An arrow strikes my breastplate and its bounce shoves me back.

lines.zh: 有股力量透过铁甲，直往里钻。
lines.en: Something seeps through the iron and goes deeper.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，这身甲忽然更沉。
lines.en: My stomach's empty, and the armor suddenly weighs more.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，铁全成了导体。
lines.en: Lightning hits the plate, and the iron becomes a wire.

lines.zh: 铁甲带着我往下沉，抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: The armor drags me down; there's nothing to grip.
